spec_match.rationale: Probes the proposal's exact nullable audioStartTime/audioEndTime instance surface and the LegacyNoInterfaceObject trap, matching web-speech-api PR #192.

interactive.rationale: Real controls drive real SpeechRecognition calls with distinct outcomes per state.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Feature-index card matches the page's delivered behavior.

edge_cases.rationale: Handles absent constructor, permission-denied (not-allowed), property-absent, and null-value cases distinctly.

references.rationale: ChromeStatus entry and explainer links present.

conformance.rationale: The root suite renders honestly in this browser (blocked rather than fake passes) and matches the instance-probe contract.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless-Chrome CDP run 2026-08-16 with zero console errors and zero failed requests.

telemetry_health.rationale: showcaseTelemetry asserts cover the probe/inspect/error branches.

design_system.rationale: Shared variables, AA pairs, focus-visible styles present.

accessibility.rationale: Native buttons, aria-live output regions, labelled sections, focusable code blocks.

openQuestions.title: Expose the sample's timing source in the timeline axis
openQuestions.detail: The SAMPLE badge labels the transcript region; consider also badging the rendered track so a screenshot of the timeline alone cannot be mistaken for live recognition timing.

guidanceConsulted.query: review pass: accessible live output, honest capability fallbacks, keyboard operability for existing concept demo
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Verify semantic controls, live-region announcements for async state, visible focus, and honest unsupported states rather than fake success.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Review-only critique (no frontend change shipped with it): the rubric's accessibility and runtime_evidence scores applied this guidance as the review bar; the page itself was not modified.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: Headless-Chrome CDP drive of the page's primary controls on 2026-08-16 with console/network capture.

summary: Live listen path errored honestly (not-allowed, labelled unrelated to the timestamps API); the sample path rendered four caption segments with start/end times, a 4-child track, and a visible 'SAMPLE — not a live recognition result' badge; clear resets. Zero console errors.
